newsitem.title: USA: Techs stocks, broad market losses pressure Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Techs stocks, broad market losses pressure Nasdaq.

text.p: Nasdaq shares dropped further Thursday amid weakness in technology stocks and continued declines in the Dow Jones industrials and in the bond market, traders said.
The Nasdaq composite index lost 9.87 points or 0.68 percent to 1436.37. Declining issues beat gainers 2257 to 1998 on total volume of about 619 million shares.

"There was a bearish sentiment on technology stocks late in the day. And the mutual funds were not doing much buying, so when stocks were unprotected, the short sellers came in and put some pressure on the techs," one trader said.
Intel Corp dropped 3 to 143-11/16, fueling the gloomy outlook on technology issues, traders said.

Komag Inc, the most active Nasdaq issue, dropped 6-14/16 to 16-11/16 after it warned its results for the rest of the year would fall short of expectations due to weak demand for disk drives. Komag makes thin-filmed media used to store data on computer hard disk drives.
A downgrade in disk drive maker Read-Rite Corp by PaineWebber also contributed to the sector's woes, traders said. Read-Rite fell 2-2/16 to 20-1/16, while Quantum Corp dropped 1-1/16 to 19-15/16.
